at: A prince of Goguryeo, blood in the packed earth
alt: Yamcha-pose parody: Ulbul bloodied on his back in a village yard, one arm flung over his head, salt sack spilled; the old woman holds the shoe.
scene: INTRO-CARD movie still, same film stock as the character cards: webtoon face, painterly world, 2.5D painted volume, quasi-sculpted folds, NOT a white studio void, NOT photoreal, NOT flat cel. WIDE-ISH, worm's-eye from the packed earth. ONE DEVICE: Ulbul's body as a hard diagonal across the lower third — a YAMCHA DEATH-POSE parody (Dragon Ball): lying on his BACK, one arm flung BACK over his head, the other limp at his side, one knee bent, eyes half-shut, blood at the mouth and brow, straw satgat knocked off, white hemp dirty, spilled salt sack. FACE from the sheet. Tiny in the midground: two unnamed commoners in undyed white walking AWAY, sticks down. FAR RIGHT small: OLD WOMAN, white hair, undyed hemp, ONE SHOE in her hand, watching. BACKGROUND is a REAL Korean village yard: timber hut, thatch, packed earth, pale dusk sky — the place is painted, not empty paper. #C30000 a thin red in the sash and the blood only, never a glow. No crowd catalog. No text. Composed for a 2:1 letterbox crop; nothing important at the top or bottom edge.
